result.title: From Tokens to Trajectories: Parameter-Efficient Continuous Adaptation of Unified Multimodal Models
result.summary: While discrete tokenization in Unified Multimodal Models (UMMs) establishes strong semantic reasoning, it introduces a strict quantization bottleneck that degrades fine-grained visual details, often resulting in structurally accurate but artifact-heavy images. We introduce FlowShift, a parameter-efficient post-training framework that bypasses this bottleneck by converting pre-trained discrete UMMs into continuous rectified-flow generators. Instead of discarding the backbone's semantic priors, FlowShift replaces discrete visual interfaces with continuous latent projections and applies LoRA to the attention layers. To efficiently boost visual quality without semantic drift, we propose Dual-Objective Velocity Vector Distillation (DOVD), which aligns the model with a high-fidelity continuous teacher and ground-truth continuous trajectories. This approach drastically improves perceptual quality while preserving prompt adherence and reasoning. When applied to leading discrete UMMs, FlowShift significantly improves COCO-30K FID and aesthetic scores, while retaining over 99.5% of multimodal understanding capabilities. Ablations confirm DOVD drives generation quality. Ultimately, FlowShift achieves high-fidelity continuous generation without sacrificing pre-trained semantic grounding.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 FlowShift，把预训练离散 token 的统一多模态模型后训练为连续 rectified-flow 生成器：用连续 latent 投影替换离散视觉接口、对注意力层加 LoRA，并以双目标速度向量蒸馏（DOVD）对齐连续教师与真值轨迹，在保持多模态理解能力的同时提升图像保真度。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「离散量化瓶颈导致细粒度视觉细节丢失」的判断与 LVR 中视觉证据是否保留在内部状态的问题相通，连续 latent 投影加轨迹蒸馏可能可供核查是否有助于缓解潜空间细节坍缩，但原文目标是图像生成质量而非推理。
